rule.text: K-GASPATH = the gas-path subset of system.physics_closure only, extracted only if an active consumer is confirmed (v3 finding: its golden_v2 consumers are historical)
rule.source: docs/rust_migration/simulation_completion_programme_v1_1.json work_packages SC-WP-02 element 'compressor' notes; docs/rust_migration/component_inventory_v3_1.json extract_and_parity_kernels K-GASPATH v3_status EXTRACT_ONLY_IF_AN_ACTIVE_CONSUMER_IS_CONFIRMED

decision_statement: No active consumer of the gas-path subset of abep_sim/system.py::physics_closure exists in the selected hall_icp_neutralizer chain. K-GASPATH is therefore not extracted, no parity contract is registered for it and abep-gaspath carries no part of system.py. The active upstream gas path (intake IF-A1 record -> F2 filter -> F3 DragCompressor physics -> F4 plenum / feed) is abep_sim/design/plenum_feed.py::Chain and its steady / transient solvers, which this lane ports under PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_DESIGN_PLENUM_FEED_PY-V1 (DragCompressor and the reservoir physics under their own contracts). The hall_1stage card, its Xe cathode and the p_min_Pa default are not ported (they are reached only through the class-H closure).

evidence.search: grep for physics_closure / gas_path_state / gaspath_physics over every *.py of the tree at the base commit (abep_core excluded), each hit classified against component_inventory_v3_1.json

consumers_found.role: golden_v2 gas_path / hall_icp_neutralizer_reference cases: historical (RM-OQ-06, RM-R28); hall_icp_neutralizer_reference is AFI-04 HISTORICAL_REGRESSION_COMPATIBILITY and excluded from SC-WP-15

class_a_references_that_are_not_consumer.what: names abep_sim.system.physics_closure as the producer of schema raw_closure_v2 in config/SOURCES_OF_TRUTH.json (a pointer string; no gas-path value is read)
class_a_references_that_are_not_consumer.follow_up: SC-WP-12 config lane: re-point the raw-result producer when the class-H closure leaves the active graph (not done here: config/** is outside this lane)

class_a_references_that_are_not_consumer.what: source-text check that system.py carries 'def physics_closure' (A9.22 application evidence of a historical commit); no gas-path value is read

PRE_RUST profiling workload system_evaluate_gas_path (rank 4, 'NOT_A_BOTTLENECK'); performance is reported, never a criterion (A9.24 items 1, 6), and a slow legacy workload is retired, never ported because it is slow (RM-R25)

evidence.active_design_modules_result: none imports abep_sim.system or calls physics_closure; F7 / F8 consume plenum_feed (filter_cases, CompressorPlant, Plenum, intake_side, steady_sweep, steady_operating_point, Chain)
evidence.active_golden: SC-WP-15: the new active hall_icp_neutralizer golden is generated only from the admitted active Rust chain; golden_v2 gas_path and the hall_1stage-computed hall_icp_neutralizer_reference are excluded (excluded_legacy_not_ported)

consequences: SC-WP-02 admission criterion 'K-GASPATH harness-independence check: the Python path through Config(hall_1stage) reads no card field (RM-R20)' is NOT_APPLICABLE: no K-GASPATH contract exists, no Python harness traverses the card
aochem.inlet_composition is not pulled forward by this lane (it would have been pulled only by an extraction)

C-ABEP_SIM_SYSTEM_PY stays HISTORICAL_LEGACY_REGRESSION / NOT_PORTED_RETIRE_FROM_ACTIVE_GRAPH with no extracted kernel; its golden_v2 cases stay reproducible from the historical Python environment (RM-R28)
reopen_trigger: a class-A consumer that reads gas-path values from physics_closure is identified (e.g. by the SC-WP-15 active golden design): then a K-GASPATH contract is registered under its own commit before any comparison
what_this_is_not: not a change of system.py, golden_v1 / golden_v2 or any frozen dataset
not a physics finding: it records only that no active consumer exists
